issue.fix: Suggestion: apply the converter “{op}”. You have to apply it yourself — the importer never changes values on its own.
issue.gotoRecord: Jump to the record from row {row}
issue.gotoColumn: Jump to the column “{field}” in the mapping
issue.sourceLegend: Where the finding comes from: “AVefi schema” are rules of the consortium — what the efi-conv service checks against the schema, plus the mandatory fields this application already checks in the mapping and on the finished record. “Across records” is checked by efi-conv across several records. “Completeness” are rules of this application that go beyond the schema and recommend what makes a record comparable with other holdings. “Conversion” was noticed while reading the file.

error.no_institution: Your account is not assigned to an institution. Without one no import can be created — please contact your administration.
error.no_filename: The file has no name. Please name the file and upload it again.
error.no_extension: The file has no extension, so its format cannot be determined. Please add the matching extension (for example .csv or .xlsx) and upload it again.
error.format_unsupported: The importer cannot read files ending in “.{ext}”. Supported are CSV, TSV, XLSX, XML, EAD, MARC-XML and JSON.
error.workbook_unsupported_xls: The file is in the old Excel format (.xls). The importer only reads workbooks as .xlsx. Open the file in Excel or LibreOffice, choose “Save as” and pick the format “Excel Workbook (.xlsx)”, then upload it again. Alternatively save the sheet you need as CSV.
error.workbook_unsupported_ods: The file is in the OpenDocument format (.ods). The importer only reads workbooks as .xlsx. Open the file in LibreOffice, choose “Save as” and pick the format “Excel 2007-365 (.xlsx)”, then upload it again. Alternatively save the sheet you need as CSV.

generic.title: Something went wrong
generic.text: The page could not be built. The error is shown below.

advice.identifier_not_unique: Two records carry the same identifier, and the schema check will not pass that. Either the rows describe the same object — then adjust how works are formed — or the mapped column is not suitable as an identifier.
advice.identifier_duplicate: The source file assigns the same item identifier twice. If these are two items, each needs its own identifier; if it is one, the rows belong together.
advice.dangling_reference: A record points to another one that the delivery does not contain. Usually the work is missing for a manifestation, or the item for a work, because the mapped column was empty in that row.
advice.no_items_associated: This manifestation has no item. AVefi requires at least one item per manifestation; without it the delivery is rejected.
advice.authority_ambiguous: The name matches several authority records. The importer deliberately fills in no ID. The column lets you narrow the authority source; which record is meant you choose in the record editor under “same_as”.
advice.schema: The value does not match what the AVefi schema allows here. A converter in the mapping often helps: “date” for dates, “duration” for running times, “number” for numbers.
advice.missing_identifier: The record has no identifier. Without has_identifier no PID can be assigned later. In the mapping a column has to point at an identifier, or a fixed value has to supply one.
advice.validation_unavailable: The validation service could not be reached. The file was produced but not checked — this report says nothing about schema conformance. “Reconvert” starts the check again.

issueText.schema__type: {field} expects a value of type {expected}, found “{value}”.
issueText.schema__pattern: “{value}” does not have the expected form for {field} ({expected}).
issueText.schema__additionalProperties: {field} contains properties the schema does not provide there: {extra}.
issueText.model_invalid: efi-conv cannot load the record: {field} does not match the AVefi model.
issueText.model_invalid__missing: efi-conv cannot load the record: the required property {field} is missing.
issueText.model_invalid__enum: efi-conv cannot load the record: “{value}” is not an allowed value for {field}. Allowed: {expected}.
issueText.model_invalid__literal_error: efi-conv cannot load the record: “{value}” is not an allowed value for {field}. Allowed: {expected}.
issueText.model_invalid__extra_forbidden: efi-conv cannot load the record: {field} is not provided at this position in the AVefi model.
issueText.model_invalid__list_type: efi-conv cannot load the record: {field} must be a list.
issueText.model_invalid__string_type: efi-conv cannot load the record: {field} must be text.
issueText.model_invalid__union_tag_invalid: efi-conv cannot load the record: its category is none of the expected ones ({expected}).
issueText.rule_period: efi-conv check rejects the record: a period ends before it begins.
issueText.rule_date: efi-conv check rejects the record: a date is not in a valid form. Expected is YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD, also as a period with “/”.
issueText.rule_field_limit: efi-conv check rejects the record: a title or a note is longer than allowed.
issueText.rule_empty_name: efi-conv check rejects the record: a person, place, genre or subject has no name.
issueText.rule_title_type: efi-conv check rejects the record: the type of the main title does not fit the level. A work allows main title or archive title, a manifestation or item allows title proper or archive title.
issueText.rule_removed_without_pid: efi-conv check rejects the record: an item is marked as removed but has no AVefi PID yet. Removed items are only delivered once they are registered.
issueText.rule_invalid_value: efi-conv check rejects the record: a value violates an efi-conv rule.
issueText.rules_unavailable: The additional efi-conv rules could not be applied to this record. It is unchecked in that respect.
issueText.identifier_not_unique__rows: The identifier {key} is not unique; it also appears in row {stellen}. | The identifier {key} is not unique; it also appears in rows {stellen}.
issueText.identifier_not_unique__records: The identifier {key} is not unique; it also appears in checked record {stellen}. | The identifier {key} is not unique; it also appears in checked records {stellen}.
issueText.dangling_reference: The reference {ref} points to no record in this delivery.
issueText.validation_unavailable__schema: The check against the AVefi schema was not possible. The file was produced but not checked.
issueText.validation_unavailable__crossref: The cross-record check was not possible. Identifiers and references were not checked.
issueText.missing_title: The record has no title. AVefi requires a main title.
issueText.item_without_manifestation: There is no manifestation for this item; is_item_of remains empty.
issueText.mapping_failed: The row could not be converted to AVefi.
issueText.unmapped_field__language: The language was not taken over: without a mapping profile it cannot be decided whether it means the language of the manifestation or of the subtitles.
issueText.unmapped_field__work_type: The work type was not taken over: it has to be mapped to an AVefi vocabulary, which needs a mapping profile.
issueText.unmapped_field__contributor: The contribution “{role}” was not taken over: the role has to be mapped to an AVefi vocabulary.
issueText.issues_truncated: {n} further errors and warnings are not listed individually.
issueText.read_failed: The file could not be read completely.
issueText.no_records: No usable records were found. The file may be empty or structured differently than assumed.
issueText.workbook_unreadable: The workbook could not be read.
issueText.no_usable_sheet: No sheet contains a header row with at least two columns and one data row. Cover sheets and legends alone do not make an import.
issueText.workbook_format_unsupported__xls: The file is in the old Excel format (.xls). The importer reads workbooks in .xlsx format. Please choose “Excel Workbook (.xlsx)” under “Save as” in Excel or LibreOffice and upload again, or save the sheet as CSV.
issueText.workbook_format_unsupported__ods: The file is in OpenDocument format (.ods). The importer reads workbooks in .xlsx format. Please choose “Excel 2007-365 (.xlsx)” under “Save as” in LibreOffice and upload again, or save the sheet as CSV.
issueText.no_header: The file contains no readable header row.
issueText.authority_in_name: The name field contains an identifier. Authority data belongs in same_as; has_name stays the name.
issueText.hint_noPrimaryTitle: The record has no main title. The AVefi schema requires it on the WorkVariant, and without a title a work can neither be found in the network nor matched with holdings. Either no column leads to a title, or the cell in this row is empty.
issueText.hint_noWorkType: The record has no work type. The AVefi schema requires it on the WorkVariant. Either no column leads to “Work › Work type”, or the cell in this row is empty; a fixed value supplies it for the whole holding.

diagHint.parse_unreadable: Check whether the upload was complete.
diagHint.parse_too_large: Examine the file with a local JSON checker.
diagHint.parse_json_comma: Remove a surplus comma or add a missing comma between entries.
diagHint.parse_json_string: Close the string with "; write contained " as \" and line breaks as \n.
diagHint.parse_json_quotes: JSON requires double quotes (") around keys and text, not single ones.
diagHint.parse_json_colon: A colon belongs between key and value: "key": value.
diagHint.parse_json_literal: Only true, false and null are allowed, lower case and without quotes.
diagHint.parse_json_other: Check brackets, commas and quotes at the marked position.
diagHint.parse_xml_nesting: Check the nesting of the elements.
diagHint.parse_xml_attr: Attribute values must be quoted and may occur only once per element.
diagHint.parse_xml_other: Check elements, nesting and the escaping of & < > at the marked position.
diagHint.parse_encoding: Spot-check special characters in the result. In the long run, exporting as UTF-8 is the safer way.
diagHint.parse_ragged: Probably an unescaped delimiter or quote. Put fields containing {delimiter} in "…".
diagHint.parse_no_header: The first row must contain the column names.
diagHint.parse_header_only: Add at least one data row.
diagHint.parse_ragged_total: Export the file again with a constant number of fields.
